title: EBSB
subtitle: Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat
description: As part of the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat initiative, IndicSense hosts Sangam, an annual cultural showcase highlighting diverse Indic art forms from the different states of India. The event brings people together to discover and celebrate the traditions of their own states as well as others. Through this journey, Sangam aims to deepen appreciation for the rich Indic knowledge preserved through these art forms, while fostering a shared sense of unity, identity, and connection among performers and audiences alike.

title: SPIC MACAY IIITDM
subtitle: Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music And Culture Amongst Youth
description: SPIC MACAY IIITDM Kancheepuram chapter brings the best of Indian classical music, dance, folk arts, crafts, yoga, and holistic arts to the campus. Through concerts, workshops, lec-dems, intensives, and heritage walks, we create immersive experiences that connect students with the depth and beauty of Bhāratiya kalā and paramparā. Our chapter hosts regular events featuring eminent artists and gurus from across the country.
